intro: Kenya is East Africa's biggest economy, known for tea, flowers, tourism and mobile money.

chapters.title: Tea and flowers
text: Kenya is one of the world's biggest tea exporters, and roses grown near Lake Naivasha are flown to Europe overnight.

chapters.title: Silicon Savannah
text: M-Pesa, launched in 2007, lets people send money by phone; most adults use it. Safari tourism is a major earner.

keyTerms.meaning: Sending and storing money using a mobile phone.

cardGroups.title: Made in Kenya
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Kenya makes and sells to the world.
